featured_reviews.name: Omkar Kinkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Timezone at Phoenix Palladium is hands-down one of the best spots in Mumbai for a fun day out. They have the latest immersive VR games like Virtual Rabbids and Dark Mars VR, which are absolutely thrilling. Beyond video games, the social play options are fantastic. We had an incredible time hitting the bowling lanes and driving the bumper cars, making it the perfect spot to hang out with a group of friends or family. It is also a very popular party venue, and I saw a dedicated area set up for a kid’s birthday party which looked well-managed.What really sets this Timezone apart are their incredible weekday promotions. If you want to make your budget stretch further, planning a visit during the week is a must. On Half Price Tuesdays, all video and ticket games are 50% off. On Fun Treats Wednesdays, the attractions drop to half price. Thursdays are a steal with bowling for just ₹99 and select games for ₹9, and Friday evenings offer great reload bonuses on their app.The staff is friendly, the environment is high-energy, and redeeming Powertickets at the Prize Shop at the end of the day is always a rewarding experience. We discovered YEY Yaya Kids Club while we were in Bombay for shopping. My wife and I had our little one with us and he was getting bored, so we decided to try this place for about 1.5 hours (₹650) and honestly, it was completely worth every rupee.

My child didn’t get bored even for a minute.

They also have a big indoor play area, in-house café, and even paid games for extra fun. The space is clean, safe, colourful and very well managed. You can also host birthday parties here which we noticed a lot of parents doing, it’s a perfect setup for that.

What I really liked is that it gives parents a break while kids are happily engaged in a proper play environment. For us, it turned a tiring shopping day into a smooth one because our kid came out smiling and exhausted in the best way 😄

If you’re in Bombay with kids, this place is a life-saver.
Highly recommended. We’ll definitely be coming back. 👍

featured_reviews.name: Gerry Savage
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited on a weekday (Wednesday) but were charged the weekend entry price without any prior notice. It was not a government or national holiday. After being charged, I noticed the bill listed a weekend rate, and when I questioned it, I was told it was because of Pongal (which is not a national holiday). There were no signs, notices, or verbal mention before payment that weekend pricing would apply.
There are excessive restrictions throughout the facility (what children can do, what they can play with, and even how they’re allowed to play). In the pretend play area, costumes are not allowed to be removed from the spot and are only permitted for photos. My child was asked to remove a costume, yet there is no signage explaining this rule. If the area is for photos only, that should be clearly stated.
In the arcade, you only get one play. Several amenities were also not functioning, including the crane game and the rock-climbing area. Other areas were taped up, torn, or visibly run down, making the place feel poorly maintained and potentially unsafe.
There are also rules about where adults are allowed, but no clear indication of which areas are restricted. Overall, the staff managed the space in a very stern manner, which is not appropriate for a children’s play area.
Between the misleading weekday pricing, excessive and unclear rules, broken attractions, and poor maintenance, the experience was extremely disappointing. What was supposed to be a fun outing for my three-year-old turned into a frustrating and unpleasant experience. At best, the practices feel dishonest.

featured_reviews.name: Pinkesh Kamwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Smaaash Lower Parel — Still Brings Out My Inner Child
I’ve been visiting Smaaash Lower Parel for more than a decade, and it’s one of those rare places that has managed to grow with time without losing its core charm.
Back in the day, it was all about adult-oriented fun — late nights, high energy, friends, and honestly, partying like an animal. The go-karting, especially at night, has always been a personal favourite, along with the bowling arenas, cricket box, and a wide mix of adrenaline-packed games that made it a go-to hangout spot.

Fun fact: I’ve literally celebrated every phase of life here — I even had a breakup party at Smaaash in 2014, which somehow makes my bond with this place even stronger 😄.

What I really appreciate now is how Smaaash has evolved over time. Initially, the focus was clearly more on adults, but lately they’ve done a great job of introducing kid-friendly games without taking away the excitement that adults come for.
Last night felt like a full-circle moment. I visited with my 11-year-old nephew and 7-year-old niece, and they absolutely loved it. From the games to the overall vibe, they were completely engaged and having a blast. Seeing the same place work just as well for kids today as it once did for us adults was genuinely satisfying.
Smaaash still does what it’s always done best ,it brings out your inner child, no matter your age. And now, with the younger generation hooked, I’m pretty sure I’ll be coming here regularly again.
A place full of memories, that adapts with time and still delivers fun... Smaaash Lower Parel continues to hit the mark.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Hrishikesh Doke
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited this kids' play zone and found that while the facilities are good, there are some areas that need improvement to enhance the overall experience and safety of children.

1. Overcrowding: The play area was extremely crowded in peak hours, making it difficult for children to enjoy the activities comfortably and safely. Limiting the number of visitors during peak hours or introducing timed slots could help.

2. Insufficient Care Staff: There appeared to be too few staff members supervising the play area. Additional attendants would help monitor children's safety, manage activities better, and assist parents when needed.

3. Parents Inside the Play Area: Many parents were sitting within the play zone itself, creating obstructions and reducing the available space for children to play freely.

Suggestions for Improvement:

- Implement a maximum occupancy limit.
- Increase the number of trained care staff during busy hours.
- Prepare guidelines for kids as well as parents.
- Regularly monitor crowd levels to ensure a safe and enjoyable environment.

With these improvements, the play zone can provide a much better experience for both children and parents.

featured_reviews.name: Shambhavi Paradkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently celebrated our daughter’s birthday at Funkey Monkey Playzone, and we are extremely happy with the entire experience. It was a well-managed and memorable event – truly paisa vasool!

Food:
The food arrangement was excellent – delicious, kid-friendly, and perfectly suited for the occasion. Many of our guests specifically complimented the taste and quality. We were also pleasantly surprised when the team offered us an additional main course dish complimentary, staying well within the agreed budget. A lovely gesture!

Decoration:
The decoration exceeded our expectations. The team went above and beyond by adding a few beautiful elements on their own, which weren’t part of the original plan. The combination of pastel shades looked elegant and festive. We really appreciate the extra effort!

Funkey Monkey Team:
A big shoutout to Samina and Neha, who were incredibly supportive and attentive throughout the planning and during the event. They ensured everything went smoothly and were always available when needed.

Play Area & Tattoo Artist:
The play area was a hit – not just for the kids, but for many of the adults too! The tattoo artist was a great addition, and even grown-ups joined in the fun. It really added to the lively and playful atmosphere.

Suggestions for Improvement:

It would be great if the food could be kept warm till the end of the party, as it was a bit cold by the time guests were eating.

The washroom area felt quite hot, which made it a bit uncomfortable while changing kids' clothes. Some ventilation or cooling would help.

Despite the couple of minor points, the entire experience was fantastic. Thank you so much to the entire Funkey Monkey team for making our daughter’s birthday so special. We highly recommend this venue for kids' parties and celebrations!

featured_reviews.review_text: Discovered this fun place for kids recently and surprisingly I ended up enjoying it as much as the kids. I was here at my nephews birthday party so I imagined this to be only for kids but I was glad to find out that adults can use almost the entire play area too. Theres a trampoline zone, ball pit, slides, arcade games and so much more that we ended up playing as much as the kids. It just brings out the child inside you. And no doubt the kids had a blast till the place was shut. Do take ur kids and enjoy with them!

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Surve
featured_reviews.review_text:

The decorations and music created such a lovely party vibe, and the tattoo artist was a big hit with the children! Everything was well-organized and stress-free for parents.
Special thank you to Tejashree and Manoj for helping me out with the planning, you guys were very supportive.

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Parkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you Bacha Party for organising my son's birthday so well. The decoration was lovely, food was tasty and good and kids as well as adults enjoyed the indoor play area a lot! Thank you once again......

featured_reviews.name: Tejaswini
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently celebrated my daughter’s birthday at Bachcha Party, and the experience was absolutely wonderful. Everything from the play area itself to the décor, food, and overall arrangements was perfectly done and truly exceeded our expectations.

A special mention to Dikshita and Archi, who helped us plan the entire celebration. They were extremely cooperative, attentive, and ensured that everything ran smoothly. Their effort and support made the whole experience stress-free and enjoyable for us.

The food quality was excellent, the setup looked lovely, and the kids had an amazing time. I would highly recommend Bachcha Party to anyone looking to host a fun and well-organized celebration for their little ones.

Thank you for making my daughter’s birthday so special! 🎉

featured_reviews.name: samiksha devrukhkar
featured_reviews.review_text: I organised my daughter’s 5th birthday party just today with full occupancy and trust me it was the best decision ever. My daughter frequently visits Baccha Party Matunga to play n enjoy and so she wanted to celebrate her bday there. Whole staff is very polite and kind especially Ms.Pallavi. She was very humble and helpful and always available to clear your doubts. She helped me with package for food and everything in a way that it fits my budget. Thank you to all the staff members and it’s definitely worth very single penny. Definitely recommend everyone to visit

featured_reviews.name: neha varhadi
featured_reviews.review_text: The play area is huge and has many activities for the kids to easily spend 3 hrs or so without getting bored. The staff was helpful and courteous. Food was tasty and the staff  made sure to modify as per our demands . In all we have a good time celebrating my kids birthday there.

featured_reviews.name: Sonali Hegishte
featured_reviews.review_text: A big shout out for Baccha Party Matunga, for hosting such a fabulous party on my daughter's Birthday.. Everyone including adults enjoyed & had a blast.. The staff were cooperative and just took the lead with everything.. all kids loved the activities, slides and the game arcade.. It was so lovely to be able to just relax and watch them have so much fun.. coming to the food, taste n the quantity was spot on, never had to ask or wait for anything.. in short, The party was a hit! And we all had an amazing time!! Thank you so much for everything 🙏

name: The Game Palacio
description: The Game Palacio brings a serious game to the city’s loudest mall. Bowling that gets competitive fast. Arcade hits you can’t stop playing. A resto bar that feels like the afterparty already started. This is where birthdays get louder, groups get rowdy, and casual plans spiral into scoreboards, snacks, and “one more round.” Skip the food court, this is where you actually want to be. Great food, full-volume fun, and energy that doesn’t quit. When the vibe’s off the charts, you’re probably here.

featured_reviews.name: Vedant Khakhrodia
featured_reviews.review_text: Game Palacio Kurla is a must-visit. It successfully merges a luxury lounge with a high-octane gaming zone. If you want a day filled with "games, arcade, good food, and drinks," this is easily one of the best spots in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: yangmi makang
featured_reviews.review_text: The bowling was a great experience, amazing ambiance, well equipped with the game tools and well maintained, cleanliness was good. Well indeed, it's a good place where you can hang out, which staff's professionalism elevate hospitality but I could definitely notice the lack of professionalism in staff and that's  a big concern to work on in.

featured_reviews.name: Ajish Narayan
featured_reviews.review_text: We Hosted our company party at Game Palacio Kurla location and it was an absolute blast! The atmosphere was vibrant and the perfect mix of competition and socializing. The gaming area was fantastic—our team loved specific bowling/arcade. Huge shoutout to Ms. Namrata who helped us through out the event and the staff for keeping the drinks flowing and the energy high. The food was surprisingly great for a gaming venue, especially fish finger. Highly recommend for a fun, stress-free team event!!!

featured_reviews.name: Harshvardhan kamble
featured_reviews.review_text: It was our first time for Bowling. There is no prior reservation required it is first come first serve basis. Since it was weekend we were charged 500+ taxes with buy one get one offer and this offer is from morning uptil 4 PM, 20 balls each player. It was a fun experience though and you can visit with ur friends here. On one bowling track four players can play together. There is screen above which tells u about score among players. There are other games too and for which u need to pay different charges. There is attached resto- bar where you can enjoy meal( it has its own menu and need to pay according to menu). Overall it was an amazing experience.

featured_reviews.name: Krishna Madhwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Game Palacio. The overall vibe of the place is great, but the service completely ruined it for us.

The staff (Sumit) was extremely rude and unprofessional. We were pressured to place our food order because the staff wanted to close the kitchen — even though it was still one hour before the official closing time. Instead of politely informing us about last order timings, the approach was pushy and disrespectful.

When customers visit a premium place, they expect basic courtesy and professionalism. Unfortunately, that was missing here. Management seriously needs to train their staff on customer handling and hospitality.

Very disappointed with the service experience. Would think twice before visiting again.

featured_reviews.name: LM Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: In case one wants to enjoy good music, food and bowling alley all at one place, this is the place. Great crowd. Alcohol, cocktails and mocktail are served. Waiting for your chance of bowling may take up to an hour during weekends.
